steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Food Safety Act 1990 is the key UK legislation: it requires food businesses to ensure food is safe, not harmful to health, and labelled accurately. | Key Fact: Under the Food Safety Act, it is an offence to sell food that is unfit for human consumption, or to describe food falsely (e.g. mislabelling). | Key Fact: Environmental Health Officers (EHOs) enforce food safety law: they inspect premises, take food samples, issue improvement notices, and can close businesses that pose a health risk. | Key Fact: EHOs inspect food businesses unannounced and assess hygiene based on: food handling, physical condition of premises, and confidence in management.
